evidence.P3: Plot A 'Cut the Loss' summary cites 'pull Morpheus's plug rather than mount a rescue (ev-032 sc-148)' as world-logic but chain omits ev-032 entirely (missing), and ev-044 is padded across all five plots without earning distinct membership in the objective tactical calculation

evidence.P5: Plots B 'Wager on a Man' and C 'Living Argument for Sacrifice' rehash one another — both argue self-sacrifice and share four of five events (ev-025, ev-031, ev-038, ev-044) differing only ev-032 vs ev-035, and Plot D repeats the same sacrifice stance and ev-044 miracle climax, with ev-044 appearing in all five plots

raw.commentary: Hard-marked: causal integrity fails on objective and relationship chains (thematic enablement not same-plot causation), perspective discipline fails on society plot mixing horns, membership fails on omitted ev-032 and over-reused ev-044, arcs are complete for B/C/E but dangling for A, and B/C/D are near-duplicate sacrifice arguments sharing most events.
